thag10.2:1.1: Purato pacchato vāpi aparo ce na vijjati, atīva phāsu bhavati ekassa vasato vane. || ||
thag10.2:2.1: handa eko gamissāmi araññaṃ buddhavaṇṇitaṃ phāsuṃ ekavihārissa pahitattassa bhikkhuno. || ||
thag10.2:3.1: yogipītikaraṃ rammaṃ mattakuñjarasevitaṃ eko atthavasī khippaṃ pavisissāmi kānanaṃ. || ||
thag10.2:4.1: supupphite Sītavane sītale girikandare gattāni parisiñcitvā caṅkamissāmi ekako. || ||
thag10.2:5.1: ekākiyo adutiyo ramaṇīye mahāvane kadāhaṃ viharissāmi katakicco anāsavo. || ||
thag10.2:6.1: evaṃ me kattukāmassa adhippāyo samijjhatu; sādhayissām' ahaṃ yeva, nañño aññassa kārako. || ||
thag10.2:7.1: esa bandhāmi sannāhaṃ, pavisissāmi kānanaṃ, ne tato nikkhamissāmi appatto āsavakkhayaṃ. || ||
thag10.2:8.1: mālute upavāyante sīte surabhigandhake avijjaṃ dālayissāmi nisinno nagamuddhani. || ||
thag10.2:9.1: vane kusumasañchanne pabbhāre nūna sītale vimuttisukhena sukhito ramissāmi Giribbaje. || ||
thag10.2:10.1: so 'haṃ paripuṇṇasaṃkappo cando pannaraso yathā sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo 'ti. || || Ekavihāriyo thero.
